Subject: Procurement enrollment: stakeholder cadence & MAP alignment

Hi Liam — thanks again for the conversation last week. Per our intake notes, we'd like to schedule an initial enrollment call to align on the procurement checklist, PO path, and a short mutual action plan (MAP) so both teams have the same timeline and success criteria.

Proposed agenda (30–45 min):
- Introductions & roles (procurement, finance, technical contact)
- Required intake artifacts (W9, insurance, SOC2 evidence)
- PO process: who issues POs, billing address, net terms
- Vendor setup forms & timeline (vendor master, tax forms)
- MAP: milestone dates and acceptance criteria
- Next steps / owners

Proposed slots (PST):
- Wed Jun 23, 10:00–10:45
- Thu Jun 24, 14:00–14:45
- Fri Jun 25, 09:00–09:45

Attached is our lightweight vendor onboarding checklist and the Redwood PO template for your finance team to review. If you have a procurement intake form you prefer, please attach it so we can fold it into the MAP.

Can you confirm attendees from your side and which slot works? If none of these, send a couple alternatives.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
[attachment: vendor-onboarding-checklist.xlsx (xlsx)]
[attachment: redwood-po-template.docx (docx)]

Hi Kimberly — thanks for the clear agenda. We can do Thu Jun 24 14:00 PST (that works for our procurement lead and finance). I'll have our procurement operations lead (procureco-pmo@acme.com) on the call.

Couple of notes up-front so we can be efficient on the call:
- Our standard payment terms are Net 30; please confirm Redwood can accept Net 30 on initial PO.
- Billing address for invoices: Horizons Supply, AP Dept, 120 Harbor Way, Boston, MA 02110.
- We typically require a vendor master form — I attached our intake form and our W9.

Attaching: horizons_vendor_intake.pdf, W9_Horizons.pdf

See you Thursday.

—Liam

- Net 30 is standard and fine for a first PO; finance will confirm contract-level payment terms during procurement paperwork.
- Action for call: confirm bill-to and legal entity for invoicing (we need exact legal name + tax ID to populate the PO).

I'll also pull the archived SOC2 summary to share in case they request attestation.

Thanks — Karthik

Perfect — confirmed Thu Jun 24 14:00 PST. I'll send a calendar invite with the video link and attach a draft MAP outlining milestones and owners. Please review the milestone dates below and flag anything that conflicts with your internal timelines: 

Draft MAP highlights:
- Day 0 (Jun 24): Enrollment call — confirm stakeholders and intake artifacts
- Day 1–3: Horizons submits vendor master + W9; Redwood initiates vendor record creation
- Day 3–7: Finance completes PO issuance (subject to contract approval)
- Day 7–14: First invoice processed and test billing validation

Success criteria: vendor record created in Redwood portal, PO issued and acknowledged, test invoice accepted without disputes.

Attachments: MAP-draft-20270623.pdf (short, editable). Please add your finance contact to the invite if different from the addresses above.

See you on the call.

Regards,
Kimberly
